items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Ginnie was a good singer, I liked the way she sang. She interfered a great deal with the music of the band... She would come on the bandstand and they would come over to me and ask me if I minded if she would sing

ctx.x: Anyway, what about Ginnie? Ginnie was a good

singer, I liked the way she sang. She interfered a great deal with the music of the band, even as far as getting Boyd to let certain people go, to hire other people. She interfered a great deal on the personal level.
